## wspr.rocks

https://wspr.rocks

allows sql queries that work like this 

```sql
/* the slash-asterisk pair surrounding this text creates a comment */
/* selecting * returns all columns, or you can name specific columns you need */
/* the 10 record limit can be increased to 5,000 max */

select
	*
from wspr.rx where
	time > subtractHours(now(), 100000)
	and tx_sign = 'KF8EEZ'
	and band = 14
limit 10
```

outputs results like this:

```
id,time,band,rx_sign,rx_lat,rx_lon,rx_loc,tx_sign,tx_lat,tx_lon,tx_loc,distance,azimuth,rx_azimuth,frequency,power,snr,drift,version,code

10340957923,2025-07-13 19:56:00,14,WD4ELG,36.188,-79.875,FM06be,KF8EEZ,39.479,-85.042,EM79,583,127,310,14097078,10,-23,0,2.7.0,1
10409200730,2025-07-26 20:06:00,14,KD7EFG-1,41.604,-112.292,DN31uo,KF8EEZ,39.729,-84.208,EM79vr,2367,284,85,14097060,10,-26,0,WD_3.1.7,1

```

with this database info:

```
db columns :  id,  time,  band,  rx_sign,  rx_lat,  rx_lon,  rx_loc,  tx_sign,  tx_lat,  tx_lon,  tx_loc,  distance,  azimuth,  rx_azimuth,  frequency,  power,  snr,  drift,  version,  code

bands : -1:LF,  0:MF,  1:160m,  3:80m,  5:60m,  7:40m,  10:30m,  14:20m,  18:17m,  21:15m,  24:12m,  28:10m,  50:6m,  70:4m,  144:2m,  432:70cm,  1296:23cm

dBm:W : 0:0.001, 3:0.002, 7:0.005, 10:0.01, 13:0.02, 17:0.05, 20:0.1, 23:0.2, 27:0.5, 30:1, 33:2, 37:5, 40:10, 43:20, 47:50, 50:100, 53:200, 57:500, 60:1000W

modes : code 1 = mode 2 (WSPR2,FST4W-120),   code 2 = mode 15 (FST4W-900),   code 4 = mode 5 (FST4W-300),   code 8 = mode 30 (FST4W-1800)
```
